content.title: Y2K Product Type Variant | Character Action, Detail Proof and Lockup
content.summary: A night cyclist drives a bubble-and-chrome bottle campaign through visor, pointer, shoe and turn modules. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every interface module. + Each module is triggered by one visible body or headphone action and introduces no more than one exact short word. + Waveform, control ring, play bar and fragments remain one coherent graphic system. + Boot and portrait-grid proofs verify the same character before the terminal movement. + The final lockup reunites the adult, settled fragments, recurring rings and one readable original master mark.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on one iridescent lens bubble, then reveal an original clearly adult night cyclist with a cobalt bob, amber cheek stripe, silver jacket and one compact comet mark beside the exact title "NOVA LOOP". A visible comet cursor selects one original prism water bottle; cut once to a lime-silver cycling shoe as she plants the same foot on a circular floor mark. Gather cyclist, bottle, shoe proof and both bubbles into one stable cobalt poster; hold the exact complete mark "NOVA LOOP / MOVE BRIGHT" with all body and graphic motion stopped.
required_anchors: One clearly adult character, at least four identity anchors and one compact original mark precede the module carousel.
Every graphic module introduces no more than one new short word and follows one visible body, prop or pointer action.
At least two recurring graphic anchors preserve continuity while layout geometry changes.
The final lockup reunites the complete adult, proven objects and original master mark in one still frame.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A night cyclist drives a bubble-and-chrome bottle campaign through visor, pointer, shoe and turn modules. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 固定同一成年赛博时尚角色，以眼部、发色、服装和轮廓为身份锚点；气泡、镀铬短词、光标框、产品近景和运动姿势按动作逐模块接力，每章只承担一个信息职责，终局把人物、原创物件与主标重新汇合。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult character, at least four identity anchors and one compact original mark precede the module carousel.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult character, at least four identity anchors and one compact original mark precede the module carousel."

invariants.rule: Every graphic module introduces no more than one new short word and follows one visible body, prop or pointer action.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every graphic module introduces no more than one new short word and follows one visible body, prop or pointer action."

invariants.rule: Product and wardrobe details remain bound to the same adult rather than becoming unrelated beauty inserts.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Product and wardrobe details remain bound to the same adult rather than becoming unrelated beauty inserts."

invariants.rule: At least two recurring graphic anchors preserve continuity while layout geometry changes.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "At least two recurring graphic anchors preserve continuity while layout geometry changes."

invariants.rule: The final lockup reunites the complete adult, proven objects and original master mark in one still frame.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final lockup reunites the complete adult, proven objects and original master mark in one still frame."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
